leadText: (Japanese: 「ポケットモンスター　ＸＹ」スタート直前ＳＰ　～ロード　to　カロス～ Pocket Monsters XY Pre-Start Special: Road to Kalos) is an animated series special that previews the beginning of Pokémon the Series: XY, while also showing some past events. It aired in Japan on October 10, 2013, a week before the premiere.
